name: North Carolina 4-H teen programs
org: North Carolina 4-H, NC Cooperative Extension (NC State and NC A&T)
city: Statewide, North Carolina (local 4-H office in every county)
what_you_do: Join 4-H through your county office. Then take part in teen leadership and service programs. They are NC 4-H Congress, the State Council, the Honor Club and the new Clover Crew.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 13 to 18 can join the teen programs. Age is counted as of January 1 of the program year. You join through your local county 4-H program.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the pages read. Ask your county 4-H office.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Programs and events vary by county and have their own dates on the NC 4-H calendar.
how_to_apply: Find your county 4-H program. Then enroll through 4-H Online. That is the system for joining, renewing and signing up for events.
notes: The teen page was updated April 30, 2026. Clover Crew is listed as new in 2026. Programs differ from county to county. The pages read do not give a fee or the dates for the teen events.
